title: Foundation output contract
description: Stack outputs of organization/foundation/<env>. Schema v0 for contractVersion 1. Adding outputs is compatible; renaming or removing one requires a new contractVersion. Properties marked x-secret are Pulumi secrets and must be masked by every consumer.

location.description: Azure region of the platform resources.

ingressIp.description: Public IP of the shared ingress controller.

kubeconfig.description: Admin kubeconfig (local accounts); full cluster access.

acrUsername.description: ACR admin user; app stacks build image pull secrets from it.

actionGroupIntakeId.description: Action group ops-intake (webhook to the event intake).

operationsApiHost.description: Host under which the agent release publishes its API: operations-agent.<baseDomain>.

alertWebhookKey.description: Query parameter key of the Azure Monitor webhook.

maintenanceApiKey.description: Value of the X-Api-Key header of the maintenance intake.

githubWebhookSecret.description: Signing secret of the GitHub issue webhook.

modelApiKeys.description: Model API keys by provider, e.g. anthropic or azure-openai.

opsGithubToken.description: Optional fine-grained PAT of the agent; empty when only the GitHub App is used.

githubAppPrivateKey.description: Addition: PEM private key of the agent's GitHub App; empty until stored.

ingressClassName.description: Addition: IngressClass for app Ingress rules.

clusterIssuerName.description: Addition: cert-manager ClusterIssuer (Let's Encrypt, HTTP-01) for app Ingress rules.

publicScheme.description: Addition: scheme of availability tests and the ops-intake webhook; http only while the documented Let's Encrypt fallback is active.

platformVersions.description: Addition, optional: component versions configured for the last foundation run (Kubernetes, Traefik and cert-manager charts, PostgreSQL) for run summaries and upgrade notes.
